text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the start of the new year comes
seasonal sales. I'm doing some shopping
when I notice
Tokai Teio searching the
crowd for something.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! No way! She's gone! Wh-what do I
do...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, Teio? I didn't expect
to see
your panicked face first thing in
the new year.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Preeeez! You've gotta help me!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You got separated from Tsurumaru
Tsuyoshi in the crowd? Well... She's
quite capable of finding her way back to
you. Don't you think you're worrying a
little too much?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But Prez! You don't know what
happened to Tsuru
this morning when we
visited the shrine!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Eurgh... I feel dizzy...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that's because you bowed so hard I
thought you were going to hit your head
on the ground! And you kept doing it!
Come on, let's sit down for
a bit!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Given what you've told me... I can see
why you'd
be concerned.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
How was Tsuyoshi before you became
separated?
Perhaps the answer lies
there.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
How was she? Well, she was really
excited... like
she was trying to hold
back the urge to dash.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Huh. "Holding back the urge to dash..."
Then
perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I think I might know where she is
too!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
What about these shoes? No... This pair
here is a
little pricier, but they look like
the ones President
Rudolf wears, so...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: There you are!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Teio! Hey, take a look at those
shoes! What
do you think?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
They're kiiiind of expensive, but they
look a lot
like the ones President Rudolf
wears—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I imagine they would. After all, they're
the exact same shoes. They're very
comfortable, and you can feel the
craftsmanship that went into making 
them.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Hwuh?! Am I hallucinating?
Wh-wh-why is
President Rudolf showing
up in my first dream of
the year?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry! I didn't realize we got
separated! I
thought you were right
behind me the whole
time...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You need to pay more attention to
what's going on around you! And hold
onto my hand when we
move through
crowds together!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I really am sorry! I'm totally ready to
take your
hand whenever you want to
go!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Wait. You said we got separated
at the
mall entrance. So how did you
know I was here?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It was a simple matter of deduction. I
narrowed my search based on what
stores would fulfill your desire to run,
and this was the obvious choice. How
did you figure it out, Teio?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well... It was just after we finished our
shrine visit!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And that is that for our shrine visit!
Hey,
Tsuru,
what did you pray for?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come on! Like you don't already
know the
answer to that!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. So, you're on the same
wavelength. You're both passionate
about the same thing, so it stands to
reason you'd come to the same 
conclusion.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Waaaugh!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! What's wrong? Did your legs fall
asleep or
something?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
No! But my heart feels warm and fluffy!
Like...
we're bound by the thread of our
common dream!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Just so you know, though, I won't
give up
first place, even if we're in the
same race!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Of course! I expect nothing less!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing their bonds of friendship first
thing in the new year, I burn with
newfound resolve to do my
best in the
upcoming twelve months.
